scene_spec.scene_type: event pass on a registration table

prompts.L2b: Replace the text 'GENERAL' on the event pass with the word 'BACKSTAGE', ensuring the new text matches the existing style, font, and size.

Adjust the added text 'BACKSTAGE' to match the original black color, font style, and lighting conditions of the pass, making it look seamless.
